title: Ruby OOP Basics
intro: Ruby OOP basics interview questions cover the object-oriented concepts every junior Ruby developer needs to explain confidently. This module covers class definition and instantiation, the initialize method and constructor arguments, instance variables (@name) and instance methods, attr_accessor/attr_reader/attr_writer and what each generates (no magic — they define getter and setter methods), class methods with self., inheritance with < and calling super, the four OOP pillars in Ruby (encapsulation, abstraction, inheritance, polymorphism) with concrete Ruby examples, public/private/protected method visibility, self in different contexts, and duck typing — why respond_to? is more Ruby than is_a?. Every answer includes a minimal runnable Ruby example.
